study.question: Does retaining the magnitude of the learned grouped-history readout improve validation ROC-AUC over inherited norm matching, and does the result require target queries rather than history-only queries, while preserving capacity and the frozen visible-input/training protocol?
study.hypothesis: Observation: source hashes of candidate.py and both round-7 ancestors match workspace receipts. Static/pooled/DIN AUCs are 0.6050036145/0.6102261137/0.6133619861; frozen paired_match and target_separate reach 0.6191087654 and 0.6153351064. Round-6 target/context separate hybrids reach 0.6198705488/0.6200552833; joint variants reach 0.6199300812/0.6198865703, so global conditioning and field separation did not consistently help. Round-7 balanced_target is 0.6202303849 versus balanced_context 0.6200080603 and balanced_uniform 0.6199768224; global_uniform reaches 0.6201325064 with slightly better logloss (0.1958011634 versus target 0.1958082113). Thus learned target utility over a redundant extra path is small and preliminary. In the candidate-supplied first-512 diagnostics, balanced_target weight L1 distance from equal-group uniform is 1.3053, entropy 1.8422, and target/context fixed-group summary RMS delta 0.2545: the scorer is active but activity is not predictive attribution. Source inspection shows _match_norm forces retrieval norm to the uniform-mean norm, invariant to positive rescaling of nondegenerate raw readouts. This is an algebraic information loss, not evidence that discarded magnitude is useful. Hypothesis: raw norm, which reflects cancellation/agreement among learned field values, may contain useful evidence suppressed by norm matching; if target-dependent magnitude matters, magnitude_target should improve over normalized_target and magnitude_context. Raw norms have NOT been measured in supplied receipts. Softmax mass remains one, so raw norm is not DIN unnormalized activation mass or established interest strength. No novelty claim.

nearest_work.difference: DIN uses target-conditioned weighted sums and explicitly abandons softmax to retain activation intensity. We inherit a field-adapted relation scorer, KEEP per-match-group softmax and equal occupied-group mass, and only remove the subsequent vector norm matching. This is a local radial-readout contrast, not DIN reproduction or a new attention priority claim.

Preserve allocation, original features, score construction, group weighting, field reads and fallback. Select retained raw vector instead of its norm-matched version. Cross with the exact existing history-query replacement; normalized cells reproduce ancestor forward behavior.
Frozen source utility control. Retain its full representation and add the inherited 16-coordinate grouped readout path; this round introduces no additional width or parameters.
Frozen second source best. Its target-aware field reads motivated the inherited hybrid but do not prove complementarity with paired_match.

Reported pooling/cross-attention overlap and opposing AUC/logloss changes are external cautions only. No highway, bus exchange, fusion or distillation is transferred; local redundancy is assessed using frozen uniform controls.

study.proposed_difference: A parameter-free radial intervention: compute normalized=_match_norm(raw,pooled) and retained=where(norm(raw)>1e-6,raw,pooled), then append either retained or normalized. Cross retain_magnitude True/False with target_query True/False in four standalone modules. All cells keep learned weighting and equal occupied-group masses. Parameter counts should remain 17,147,171 total / 68,483 dense for supplied metadata, exactly as the ancestor; host must measure. No optimizer, loss, data or scorer change.
predictions: Implementation: original feature width is 420 and appended width 16 for frozen metadata; normalized cells reproduce inherited forward maps; allocated count remains 17,147,171. Norm-matched summary norm equals pooled norm up to floating-point tolerance; retained summary follows raw except shared near-zero fallback.

Discriminating observation: raw/reference norm ratio varies among eligible nonempty histories, and fixed-checkpoint raw-versus-normalized logit RMS is nonzero. This only establishes representational/functional sensitivity on the first 512 impressions, not usefulness.

Utility: magnitude_target exceeds normalized_target, both frozen source bests, and g3-r0007-global_uniform in full-population validation AUC; report unweighted logloss, all supplied slices with counts, and measured costs alongside every contrast.

Conditioning: magnitude_target exceeds magnitude_context. Estimate interaction I=(AUC_magnitude_target-AUC_magnitude_context)-(AUC_normalized_target-AUC_normalized_context), reporting its sign and paired-seed variation without requiring a positive interaction for an additive conditioning effect.
Paired repeats should preserve the relevant AUC contrast directions. Whole-validation results determine selection; first-512 diagnostics and small slices are exploratory only.
falsifiers: If raw/reference ratio is effectively constant or swapping the radial mode has negligible logit impact, the implementation supplies no consequential magnitude channel on the diagnostic sample; inspect before a mechanism claim.
If magnitude_target fails to beat normalized_target, radial utility is unsupported under this implementation; it does not refute all magnitude-sensitive models.

If magnitude_target fails to beat magnitude_context, added target-query benefit is unsupported even if radial retention helps both. If only normalized_target wins, retain the incumbent and record the negative branch.
If gains are not stable across paired seeds/user-cluster uncertainty, remain preliminary. Failure to beat paired_match or global_uniform leaves incremental utility over those controls unsupported.

If normalized controls fail source/forward/parameter checks or produce unexplained seed-42 discrepancies from their ancestors, treat as reproducibility/execution concern rather than scientific counterevidence. If AUC improves while logloss or cost worsens, report the tradeoff rather than claim overall superiority.
alternative_explanations: Retraining changes embeddings, attention direction, classifier weights and checkpoint selection; a raw-versus-normalized contrast measures the entire radial-readout intervention, not a fixed-representation causal effect.

Removing norm matching changes feature scale and radial gradients together. History-query replacement controls target-query dependence, but does not separate useful magnitude information from easier optimization or implicit regularization.
